description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 985 - Order to direct that the Limit of sale by retail and the transport of maximum quantity of foreign Liquor shall be 7.5 Litres w.e.f. 01.01.2016
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the issuance of a legal notification (Excise Notification No. 985) under the Excise Ordinance, which establishes new regulatory limits for the sale and transport of foreign liquor. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities or constitute a personnel change. The core content is regulatory in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
